title: FairWind-napoli97
name: FairWind-napoli97
summary: Manage and helm a fictional 1997 12-Metre syndicate in the Bay of Naples.
description: A fictional Naples 1997 12-Metre campaign sailed from a stern chase view with perspective, a Bay of Naples horizon and a shore you cannot sail onto. Trim the sheets, set spinnaker or gennaker, play oscillating SW wind shifts and race tactical AI rivals or up to three friends under basic racing rules, with an automatic top view at marks and in close quarters.
controls: D-pad helm and sheets; A spinnaker, B gennaker, A+B penalty turn
fiction_notice: All teams, sponsors, and the Naples 1997 event depicted here are fictional. Il Moro di Venezia V is used only as a historical visual reference; no real sponsor marks are reproduced.
